title: Brand visual storytelling matrix
slide_intent: Translate strategic themes into image choices because a city’s character becomes tangible through the scenes it presents.
strategic_value: Helsinki can balance charm with confidence by pairing urban freedom and unusual experiences with sustainable, functional life.
demonstration: This webpage board places photographs, illustrations and information graphics in a matrix headed Brands’ visual storytelling, with Charm/Convince axes and Wildly Urban, Free, Extraordinary, Sustainable and Functional labels.
practical_value: Use the named themes to compare the story carried by proposed images.

content_islands.name: Storytelling matrix
content_islands.spec: Keep the orange upper themes and blue lower themes aligned with their image groups and the credit caption.

reference_purposes.Expression: The labeled collage combines urban life, nature, residents, illustration and data imagery.
reference_purposes.Application: The matrix relates example imagery to named storytelling themes.
